items.escena: A clay university student in a lab coat standing proudly beside a row of aquariums with fish and corals, gesturing toward the tanks as she introduces herself to visitors
A clay young man in the middle of a class, sketching at a desk in a busy architecture studio surrounded by small cardboard model buildings
A clay veterinary student gently examining a puppy on a table, with a gauze roll, a pet bowl, a brush and a small dog collar laid out around her
Three clay civil engineers in hard hats and safety vests on a construction site, one unrolling blueprints, one measuring a wall, one guiding a small crane
A clay student pinning photos of a kitchen, a vegetable garden and a hospital meal tray onto a corkboard, linking each one with red string to a central photo of a nutritionist

items.texto: One of the main goals of this field is to...
items.escena: Clay students planting rows of young trees on a bare brown hillside, while in the distance a neighbouring hill is already lush and green, the target they are working toward
A clay teenage girl wearing safety goggles assembling a small wheeled robot on a workbench, coloured wires and a soldering iron beside her
A clay physiotherapist helping an older man stretch his arm with a rubber exercise band in a bright rehabilitation room
Clay students in gloves picking up plastic bottles along a riverbank and dropping them into recycling sacks, green trees and clear water behind them
A clay teacher kneeling beside a young child at a small classroom table, helping her stack colourful wooden blocks while other children draw nearby
A clay young artist painting a colourful mural of birds and flowers on a village wall while another student plays a guitar nearby
A clay soccer player sitting on a bench with her leg stretched out while a sports medicine student wraps a bandage around her knee, a green field behind them
